name: Shaw's Plaza Hanover
summary: Shaw's Plaza Hanover is a grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping center located on Columbia Road in Hanover, Massachusetts. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, this convenient plaza serves the South Shore community with essential retail and services anchored by Shaw's Supermarket.
demographics: Shaw's Plaza Hanover serves the affluent South Shore Massachusetts community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes above the state median. The trade area draws from Hanover's well-educated suburban population, including young professionals and established families who value convenience and quality. Typical shoppers are between 35-65 years old, often homeowners seeking everyday necessities and services in a convenient neighborhood setting. The center benefits from Hanover's strong residential base and its position as a bedroom community with high household spending power.
description: Shaw's Plaza Hanover is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 35 Columbia Road in Hanover, Massachusetts, serving the South Shore community with essential retail and services. Anchored by Shaw's Supermarket, this plaza provides residents with a reliable destination for grocery shopping and everyday needs in a convenient open-air format. The center is strategically positioned in Hanover, a desirable suburban town known for its excellent schools and family-friendly atmosphere, making it a natural gathering point for local residents. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, Shaw's Plaza benefits from professional management and a commitment to serving neighborhood needs. The plaza's accessible location on Columbia Road ensures easy access for the surrounding residential communities, offering ample parking and a straightforward shopping experience that caters to the busy lifestyles of South Shore families.
